description: Hooks legitimately dispatched by fewer than all four runtimes. Each entry names the runtimes that dispatch it and why the asymmetry is correct. An undeclared asymmetry fails scripts/verify_activation.py.

wire-skills.py.reason: Installer that materializes the Claude skill mirror; it is not a gate and has no meaning under another runtime.

skill-usage-recorder.py.reason: Claude-only telemetry recorder. The other adapters record skill usage through lib/telemetry.py directly.

interview_session_hook.py.reason: DeepSeek cannot support turn-level session continuity because its adapter lacks native turn-start and reliable sealing lifecycle events; interview-capability.json reports it unavailable.
